questions.question_text:
Amil earns $\$9.75$ per hour.
He works a total of $37$ hours in the week.
Without using a calculator, what is his weekly salary?

options.why: Used $\$97.50$ instead of $\$9.75$ for the hourly rate: $37\times\$97.50=\$3607.50$.
Placed three decimal places instead of two in $975\times37=36075$, giving $\$36.075$.
Ignored the cents in the hourly rate and calculated $37\times\$9=\$333$.

questions.solution_text:
$975\times37=36075$. The hourly rate has $2$ decimal places.
The weekly salary is $37\times\$9.75=\$360.75$.
